name: Quiet luxury fashion
region: Italy, France and the United States
summary: The logo-free, high-cost dress of the 2000s and after. It uses cashmere, loden and fine wool in neutral colours, with perfect cut and hand finish. The price is in the cloth and not in a mark.

philosophy.core_thesis: Real luxury is quiet. It shows in the touch of the cloth and the fit of the cut, and only a person who knows will see it.
design_principles: Use no logo and no monogram on the outside of the garment.
Choose cloth of the highest grade: cashmere of 14 to 16 micron, fine wool, loden and silk.
Keep to neutral colours: camel, oatmeal, navy, grey, ivory and chocolate.
Cut a relaxed, long and straight line, with a soft shoulder and room in the body.
Finish by hand: linked knit seams, hand-set buttons and a fine hem.
Make each garment last 10 years or more, in a classic form.
Build the outfit from a few pieces that mix in one palette.
anti_patterns: Trend pieces that last a season

silhouette.shape: A relaxed, long and soft rectangle: a roomy coat, wide trousers, a fine knit and a loose shirt, in one tone.
silhouette.line: A soft, natural shoulder, a straight body, and a hem at the calf or the ankle.
silhouette.fit: Easy and generous; the cloth drapes on the body with no strain.
silhouette.proportion: Coat to mid-calf; trouser leg 22 to 26 cm at the hem; knit hem at the hip; sleeve length to the wrist bone.
rules: Cut a soft shoulder with no pad.
Keep the coat long and the trouser wide and straight.
Wear a fine knit under a coat, in a tone close to it.
Match the palette of the whole outfit within one family.
Choose a plain leather shoe or a loafer and a bag with no mark.

fabrics.rule: Choose a cloth for its touch and its life: cashmere, fine wool, loden, silk and suede, in plain weave and a soft finish.

methods: fully fashioned knitting with linked seams
construction.closures: Horn, mother-of-pearl or covered buttons, set by hand; hidden hooks and a plain zip.
construction.details: A soft collar, a patch pocket cut true to the grain, hand-rolled hems and linked seams in the knit.

surface.pattern: Plain colour; a fine herringbone, a rib or a cable that is only seen close up.
surface.gloss: Wool and cashmere at 1–5 GU; silk at 20–40 GU; suede at 1–3 GU.
surface.wear: The style wants a clean, soft and well-kept piece; slight softening with age is welcome.

palette.strategy: Warm and cool neutrals in one family: camel, oatmeal, ivory, navy, grey and brown, with no accent.

processes: limited runs with a high price
making.scale: Small luxury houses and fine workshops, mostly in Italy; made in small runs, with a high cost for each piece.
making.signs: Hand-set buttons, linked knit seams, a soft inside finish and a fine, even hand of the cloth.

pieces.form: Fine cashmere jumper with a plain crew neck
Long soft coat in loden with a plain front
Wide pleated trousers in a soft flannel
Loose cotton shirt with a soft collar
Soft unlined jacket with a natural shoulder
Long straight silk skirt with a hidden hook

evidence.title: The Row sweater and scarf at the Met (52716)

emotion.target_response: A feeling of calm wealth and trust: the viewer senses fine cloth and care, and sees no label.

use_cases: a luxury knitwear or coat line brief
a fashion image prompt for a calm, rich look
a styling guide for a wardrobe
a study note on the turn from logos
avoid_when: the brief wants a visible logo or a status mark
the brief wants a loud, young or trend look
the brief needs a low-cost synthetic line

modifiers.how: Narrow the cut, drop the warm tones for black and grey, and use crisp cloth.
Add the monogram and the print, and use bright colour and a bold bag.
